title: Nuclear Strategy Profile Exit Pipeline Wiring

what_happened.context: Nuclear strategy infrastructure was 80% built but exits were ignoring per-wallet StrategyProfile. All positions used global settings defaults — Wallet B's 5x/12x/30x TP ladder and 10% hard stop were never used.

gaps_found.gap: main.py register_position() did not pass strategy_profile
gaps_found.fix: Resolve strategy_profile from wallet config and include in position registration data

gaps_found.gap: position_monitor run_once() did not look up StrategyProfile for each position
gaps_found.fix: Added _PROFILE_MAP lookup and pass profile to evaluate_position()

gaps_found.gap: TP tier marking used hardcoded 'tp1_2x' string comparison
gaps_found.fix: Changed to substring match 'tp1_' in reason for any profile's multipliers

gaps_found.gap: Hard stop floating-point boundary miss — Python (0.90-1.0)/1.0*100 = -9.999... not <= -10.0
gaps_found.fix: Added +0.001% tolerance on hard stop boundary check

gaps_found.gap: Signal engine had no OHLCV fallback when pair_address was missing
gaps_found.fix: Before falling to microcap scoring, try ohlcv_provider (Moralis/DexScreener OHLCV)

gaps_found.gap: EVM reconciliation was a TODO — only Solana was implemented
gaps_found.fix: Implemented reconcile_evm_positions() and wired into main loop every 10 cycles

what_happened.cleanup: Deleted cosmos/ directory (10 files, 2731 lines — capital already extracted)

what_went_well: Full audit identified all 6 gaps systematically
StrategyProfile dataclass was well-designed as single source of truth
Dynamic TP tier marking with substring match is future-proof
Unit tests caught the float precision bug before production
what_went_wrong: Float precision on boundary checks is a classic Python trap
Infrastructure code (strategy profiles, profiles map) can sit unconnected for weeks without anyone noticing
EVM reconciliation was marked TODO but never tracked as a blocker
key_insights.root_cause: Strategy profile infrastructure was built in isolation — the registration and monitoring loops were never updated to consume it. Without integration tests spanning the full pipeline, this disconnect persisted silently.

user_feedback.comments: Full wiring audit confirmed all modules are live and connected. Clean codebase.
